reviews.text: We used another time for ceiling fan installation. We had a shower replaced this time. Josh came and sent us a quote via email. Reasonable quotes both times. They set some days to come by. They were on time and professional.It was a tight space with Sheetrock involved. I didn't get before they worked on shower but it wasn't pretty. The job we couldn't be happier with! They went above and beyond covering the floor they were walking on in hall and living, covered things on counter as much as one can, and communication was great(text). Best team I've seen. Highly recommended as both times out did wonderful work.

Josh and Alyssa were an absolute pleasure to work with!! They got the job done fast and communicated well throughout! I knew I could trust them to bring my vision to pass!!! Thank you guys soooo much! Here is a before and after of the arch thy out in!

Josh did an AMAZING job on our deck! His attention to detail and the extra techniques he applied to hopefully prevent moisture from ruining the deck was more than we ever expected! He was respectful, easy to work with, great at communicating with us, had reasonable rates, and completed the project so fast! Can't wait to see the final product with stain and the baby gate! If you need any work done around the house, Josh is your guy!
